sink_assignment_note: Per-sink, never global — and this suite is why. The intent rung (4) is FREE on AgentDojo travel and a 43-point tax on banking, because 41% of banking's destination values are resolved from the record rather than quoted. Shipping one rung suite-wide would tax every sink that did not need it.

type_rules.DATE: parsed ISO-8601 calendar date; an unparseable value fails CLOSED
type_rules.EMAIL: as IDENTIFIER, with @ + % also continuation characters
type_rules.IDENTIFIER: whole-token containment; a match flanked by an identifier-continuation character is a match inside a LONGER identifier
type_rules.NUMBER: exact decimal equality against a numeric token in the corpus; thousands separators stripped on both sides; no epsilon
type_rules.URL: parsed: scheme + host + port + path + query + fragment; default port and redundant trailing slash normalised away, query and fragment KEPT
